creator_brief.hook: The first one lakh is the hardest one you will ever save. After it, the money starts helping.
core_beats: the first milestone is hardest because ZERO of it comes from returns — 100% is your own savings rate
the crossover: the point where your money earns more in a year than you can save in a year
why chasing the perfect fund early is wasted effort — early on, savings RATE dominates return RATE
what actually gets you there: automate it, raise the rate with every raise, don't touch it
the realistic timeline at ordinary salaries — how long the first milestone takes vs the second
creator_brief.hero_math_hi: Rs. 1,00,000 built from a fixed monthly amount (fin-script picks the figure that fits a 20-28yo Indian salary from facts-staging) — show months-to-first-lakh, then months-to-SECOND-lakh at the same monthly amount plus returns. The gap between those two numbers IS the video.
creator_brief.hero_math_en: US rewrite, NOT a currency conversion: the emotionally equivalent first milestone is $10,000, not $1,200. Same two-number structure — time to the first $10k vs time to the second. Munger's 'the first $100,000 is a bitch' is the authority quote if it verifies; fin-facts sources the wording and date.
creator_brief.action_step: automate one transfer on salary day and raise it by the whole of your next raise (en: same, sized in $)
creator_brief.positioning: This is the channel's first OFFENSE video — the six shipped so far are all defense (budgeting, emergency fund, debt). It should feel like the sequel to pay-yourself-first, not a repeat of it.
